name: billing-retry-runbook.txt
description: Runbook for recovering declined charges when a payment processor is unavailable.
content: If the payment processor is unavailable, place the failed charge in the retry queue. Retry it after the provider reports healthy status.

name: billing-vendor-onboarding.txt
description: Checklist for adding a new payment vendor.
content: Before enabling a new payment vendor, verify the contract, tax records, settlement account, and test transaction.

name: web-tls-deployment.txt
description: Procedure for deploying a web TLS certificate.
content: Generate a certificate signing request, obtain the TLS certificate, install the certificate chain, then test HTTPS renewal alerts.

name: web-traffic-incident.txt
description: Incident response guide for a web service unable to accept traffic.
content: When the web service cannot accept traffic, check load balancer health, application error rate, and recent deployment changes before rollback.

name: people-leave-policy.txt
content: Employees may carry five unused vacation days into the next calendar year with manager approval. Remaining days expire on 31 March.

name: identity-password-reset.txt
description: Support procedure for account password recovery.
content: If a customer cannot sign in, send the password reset link after confirming the account email address. Do not disclose whether an account exists.

name: billing-retry-legacy.txt
description: Retired payment retry process for the former gateway.
content: For the retired gateway, support staff manually resubmit rejected charges once daily.
